title: Freetown Peninsula: Beach Escape
summary: Four easy nights along the peninsula's best beaches — surf lessons at Bureh, grilled fish on the sand at River No. 2, and a sunset to close each day.
highlights: A surf lesson at Bureh Beach with the local surf club
Grilled barracuda and jollof on the sand at River No. 2
A guided hike to Leicester Peak at sunrise
A full free day to do absolutely nothing

itinerary.title: Arrive & settle in
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, water-taxi across the estuary, and a first sunset at Lumley Beach.

itinerary.title: Bureh Beach
itinerary.description: A morning surf lesson with the local surf club, lunch at a beachfront grill.

itinerary.title: River No. 2 & Leicester Peak
itinerary.description: A sunrise hike for the view over Freetown, then an afternoon at River No. 2 with fresh-grilled fish.

itinerary.title: Free day & departure
itinerary.description: An open morning on the sand before your transfer back for departure.

included: Daily breakfast, 2 lunches on the beach
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
excluded: Yellow fever vaccination, if not already held
